source_findings.finding: Release describes wording clarification of existing VTI-ACL-105/-110: every read is purpose-bound; a chain stating none grants any, but not modelTraining. No version bump or implementation enforcement is demonstrated by wording.

source_findings.finding: Release bundles public JWT major transition, critical-extension rejection across five language runtimes, room load-older bounds, wake/receipt behavior and messaging additions. No single aggregate PASS follows from a release label.
